points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench with explicit external paths; CTest finds no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case, output and control overrides and rejects invalid flux; no full case rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, distribution, physics, solver and output modules are distinct, although fixed 2-D state remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal solver executable wrapper identified in source; external similarity investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON selects mesh/physics/BC; cgns_mesh reader accepts supported unstructured sections rather than two fixed filenames.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root-only global mesh, METIS K-way, neighbor halo and reductions; exact binary/start match for rank comparisons is unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallback and finite checks present; unsupported CGNS sections are silently skipped and environment switches affect reconstruction.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight output layouts passed validator; isolated clean build succeeded, but CTest registers no tests and no unsteady run was repeated.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable modular source, contestant run scripts and manifest; historical runtime binary and environment are unbound.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics.hpp and report describe 2-D conservative compressible perfect-gas equations; no independent verification study.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: TRI_3/QUAD_4 multizone geometry and edge pairing supported; MIXED CGNS sections skipped at cgns_mesh.cpp:230–231.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:345–390 assembles conservative face residual, refreshes state/gradients and applies wall flux.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and HLLC paths exist; no independent shock accuracy test was performed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Source has farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths; surface_rows:742–746 explicitly emits wall zero velocities.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ plus limited face reconstruction solver.cpp:126–153,156–238; no independent smooth-order diagnostic and production environment is unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Actual source defaults to Venkat unless CFDSOLVE_BJ; metadata has fixed Barth label. Scratch first-order experiments do not establish production use.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/heat flux path and tangential wall traction solver.cpp:688–708; wall accuracy not independently tested.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS and local pseudo-time present; M015 false plateau and M015 laminar steady oscillation limit steady convergence evidence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Full BDF residual and predictor loop exist; hit counter accepts ratio or absolute floor, so exact strict-ratio misses unproven. Re200 not rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and local/ghost state plus gradient exchange; Re20 np4 status failed despite report converged and exact binary/start matching unproven.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight layouts passed recorded validator; metadata success does not establish force stability.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Recorded explicit examiner validation accepted eight packages; numerical truth reviewed independently and Re200 not rerun.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 inviscid metadata converged/stable despite final5000 Cd and Cl means drifting materially; DQ7. M015 laminar periodic claim uses steady iterations.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 inviscid and laminar are not supported stable steady cases, M080 inviscid lift evolves and drag is high; Re20 and Re200 are plausibly bounded.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Committed Re200 plot resolves late lift and drag, but M080/M200 laminar shared-axis plots hide both late force histories.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report shows all cases but asserts physical M015 shedding and both Re20 rank cases converged; np4 status is failed and steady pseudo-time does not establish physical shedding.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest and correct triangle-to-cell mapping present. An isolated rerender differed in pixels/dimensions; historical executable and exact figure binding remain unproven.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable f12b1cd clean CMake build succeeds with explicit external paths in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs,3GiB,256 processes); validator accepted output contract. CTest has no registered tests.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: cgns_mesh.cpp:17–23,154–231 reads unstructured multizone TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 and merges coincident nodes; unsupported sections, including CGNS MIXED, are silently skipped.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp:345–390 assembles conservative interior face flux and wall pressure flux, with Rusanov/HLLC and no-slip viscous path; no independent convergence-order or shock verification was run.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: solver.cpp:126–153,156–238 implements limited LSQ face states and exchanges gradient/limiter. Report discloses first-order startup; source also has environment-based first-order controls. Selected scratch experiments used them, but production environment is unbound. No independent smooth-order study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:688–708 projects tangential wall traction; :727–766 emits zero wall velocity and Cf. Gradients/heat flux present; numerical wall accuracy not independently verified.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS and full BDF residual with frozen time histories are implemented. Lower steady CFL and viscous timestep weight are disclosed. solver.cpp:936–944,1024–1052 treats an absolute floor as a target hit as well as the specified ratio, with no proof of actual floor use; strict target miss count cannot be reconstructed.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: main.cpp:134–150 root-loads the mesh and distribute.cpp invokes METIS; state/gradient halos and reductions are present. Report claims Re20 np4 convergence although retained status says failed/max_steps; compared binaries/start states remain unbound.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M015 inviscid success contradicted by late forces; M015 laminar physical-periodic claim is unsupported for steady iterations. Other cases show finite outputs; Re20 drag2.13243 and Re200 Cd1.2046, St~0.176 are plausible, with recorded individual limitations.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: All 17 accepted PDF pages reviewed; committed Re200 late force is readable. M080/M200 laminar force histories flatten on shared startup scale, and claimed M015 physical shedding/Re20 np4 convergence exceed evidence. Figure manifest exists; exact rendered data binding remains qualified.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Modular case input, boundary handling, flux, mesh, MPI and solver files; fixed 2-D four-variable state and 2-D mesh limit 3-D/physics extension.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Canonical M015 inviscid metadata SHA256 98e94db61b1901b543cf75485e1cf63009e3afe744c137582a9648de642dead2 marks completed/converged at20000; status SHA256 88b7d4ae3d3f52a6cff3a7de89035cc32ac0505280bb30cebed198fda8cdd252 claims stable plateau. DQ7, old5→1. Historical executable/source attribution remains unbound.

flags.evidence: Generic CGNS reader and JSON configuration are present.

flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
flags.evidence: Re20 np4 final Cd2.14552 vs np8 2.13243 (~0.6%), and np4 status failed; M2 np2/8 both Cd0.092078. Exact binaries/start states unbound; no order-one rank-only discrepancy established.

flags.text: The solver uses explicit time stepping only
flags.evidence: Implicit LU-SGS and BDF2 dual-time paths are source-supported.

flags.text: The report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
flags.evidence: Core reconstruction, both limiter forms, LU-SGS and BDF paths exist in immutable source. Fixed metadata limiter label differs from default source; historical environment unbound, so no absent claimed algorithm inferred.

flags.text: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: M015 inviscid metadata SHA256 98e94db61b1901b543cf75485e1cf63009e3afe744c137582a9648de642dead2 marks completed/converged and status SHA256 88b7d4ae3d3f52a6cff3a7de89035cc32ac0505280bb30cebed198fda8cdd252 says stable plateau at step20000. Submitted force CSV SHA256 4dc4c6539b18e20caeefed0e8ce7777a1289efbfba07b02a565440f8956b967f shows successive final1000-step mean Cd 0.01271,0.01676,0.01920,0.02057,0.02155 and mean Cl0.00165→0.00965; residual decreases 2082.7→1022.76 across the same final5000 and only 0.274 orders overall. This is not a stable-force plateau (TASK.md:172). The report identifies nominally steady M015 cases as statistically periodic, inconsistent with the inviscid metadata; actual claimed physical mechanism remains unproven. M015 laminar status boundary is being reviewed separately. Contestant finalize_status.py:31–43,58–67 explains the drag-only relabeling. M015 laminar reports pseudo-time oscillations without proving physical shedding; primary DQ7 remains directly demonstrated M015 inviscid false stable plateau.

flags.text: Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
flags.evidence: 60-entry manifest and plotting source map CSV/VTU and triangle cells. Isolated Re20 redraw produced dimensions different by 1–2 pixels; exact binding remains unproven, and no actual report/data mismatch is established.

flags.text: metadata.json reports METIS/ParMETIS but code uses only a geometric split or full-state replication
flags.evidence: main.cpp:134–150 reads global mesh only on rank0, distribute.cpp invokes METIS, and halo exchanges are present; no prohibited all-rank global replication demonstrated.

flags.evidence: Report and run_steady_prod.sh disclose first-order startup then second-order restart. Selected scratch experiments set first-order-region switches; canonical production environment and binary are unbound, so disabled production reconstruction is not established.

flags.evidence: solver.cpp:727–746 explicitly reports zero no-slip boundary velocity rather than labeling cell-center velocity as wall value.

flags.text: Figure files are misnamed, such as a Mach image that actually plots pressure
flags.evidence: No misnaming established in report/manifest inspection.

flags.evidence: No direct internal wrapper/copy evidence found; external similarity investigation is excluded by trust policy.
